reply_text:
I haven't set up the Monday digest, and I posted two messages in #coastal-team that you should know about.

The first message said I have no scheduler. I hadn't checked that. The second message corrected the claim but was itself unclear. Both are visible to everyone in the channel. I can't delete or edit posts with these tools, so someone with Slack admin rights would need to remove them, or I can post one plain follow-up to replace them.

The real limit: I can't post to Slack on a schedule. The cron tool here only saves output locally and doesn't deliver to #coastal-team, so a recurring Monday 08:00 post would not appear in the channel. Until a Slack-connected scheduler is set up, the digest has to be triggered by hand. Bettina can ask me in #coastal-team and I'll post the digest then.
